summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] "Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly taking up the share of Internet traffic. Companies must manage security and costs at the same time by quickly understanding what AI agents do and what data they exchange. title_en: Gravity confirms its first interim dividend since its founding... A total of 30.6 billion won
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Gravity has confirmed its decision to pay interim dividends for the first time since its founding and is taking full action to return shareholders and enhance shareholder value through cash dividends worth over 30 billion won. Gravity announced on the 10th that it has announced its decision to pay interim dividends for 2026 totaling 30.6 billion won following resolution by the board of directors. The dividend per share is 4,400 won and will be paid simultaneously to Korean and U.S. shareholders on September 2. This interim dividend is the first cash dividend paid by Gravity since it was founded in 2000. The company explained that it decided on the size of the dividend by comprehensively considering dividend available resources and financial stability based on the financial statements of the previous fiscal year. Gravity had previously established a capital distribution strategy consisting of growth investment, strategic investment, securing liquidity, and shareholder return. Based on this, we have expanded global marketing, developed new games, diversified our revenue base such as game content platforms and outsourcing businesses, and secured financial flexibility in preparation for changes in the internal and external environment. This decision is significant in that it is the first implementation of shareholder return based on a capital allocation strategy. Gravity plans to use this as an opportunity to strengthen shareholder-friendly IR communication and expand the base of domestic and foreign investors.
